signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Enter your email and we will send you a secure sign-in link. No password required.
signIn.sentDescription: If that address is registered, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 15 minutes and can only be used once.
signIn.errorDescription: Something went wrong. Please try again.

magicLink.verifyingDescription: Hold on while we verify your link.
magicLink.invalidOrExpiredTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
magicLink.invalidOrExpiredDescription: Sign-in links expire after 15 minutes and can only be used once. Request a new one to continue.
magicLink.errorDescription: We could not verify your link right now. Please try again.
